title: Credit existing force/sense contacts without borrowing full receiver qualification
statement: ROOT reports reading Cohu Kelvin main0--78: physically separate force/sense paths, paired-tip spacings, wiping and family-specific test specifications. Those existing constructions do not qualify etched CuBe on ordinary tin0201 terminals, independent-B switching, installed5mohm total error or a complete service machine. No product/ReadMore/catalogue/contact path was followed; the switched-contact fixture remains unconstructed.

assumptions: The certificate assumes invariant or independently bounded shunt conductance during B opening. Motion of contamination, A-load/frame changes or unverified conductor separation can violate it. Counterexamples concern the specified linear ports, not every sensor. Full paired-contact qualification, tooling, wear, service recovery and production advantage remain open.
